summary.text: Saud Anwar was first elected to the Connecticut Senate in February 2019 to represent the 3rd Senate District, which covers East Hartford, East Windsor, Ellington and South Windsor.

paragraphs.text: He was first elected to public office in 2011 on the South Windsor Town Council and served two terms as South Windsor mayor, 2013 to 2015 and 2017 to 2019.
Anwar is a medical doctor specializing in lung diseases and critical care, trained at Yale University, where he also earned a Master's Degree in Public Health.
He is chair of the Department of Internal Medicine at Manchester Memorial and Rockville General Hospitals.
